title: UV-Vis Spectrum Studio

creators.name: Hasan, Abdulsalam S.
creators.affiliation: University of Mosul, College of Science, Department of Chemistry

description: UV-Vis Spectrum Studio is open-source, cross-platform scientific software for UV-Vis spectroscopy and analytical chemistry. It provides robust spectral import and cleaning, publication-quality visualization, derivative spectroscopy through fourth order with numerical and spectroscopic quality safeguards, quantitative calibration and analytical-method validation, multicomponent spectrophotometry, peak fitting and deconvolution, Fourier and wavelet analysis, chemometrics with fold-safe supervised preprocessing and nested PLS validation, and reproducible tamper-evident UVVISPROJ project archives. Release workflows produce tested platform-specific desktop distributions, source/Python distributions, checksums, dependency snapshots, and build provenance.
notes: Research, teaching, analytical-development, and analytical-support software released under the MIT License. The software is not represented by default as a validated GMP, GLP, 21 CFR Part 11, or ISO/IEC 17025 system. Laboratories remain responsible for installation/software qualification, analytical-method validation, access control, data-integrity controls, audit-trail requirements, and regulatory compliance required by their quality system. Cite the exact archived software version used in research.
